name: production-critic
description: Skeptical production readiness review. Run before declaring any substantial work done.

P0.label: Catastrophic
P0.description: App crash, auth bypass, data loss, secret leak

P1.label: Severe
P1.description: Core flow broken, security flaw, wrong data shown

P2.label: Meaningful
P2.description: Feature incomplete, significant UX issue, CI broken

requirements: All specified features are implemented, not mocked
No TODO or placeholder code paths in critical flows
android_specific: Permissions are minimal and justified in AndroidManifest
App handles process death and config changes
Insets and navigation bar are respected
auth_authz: Firebase Security Rules enforce ownership, not just client-side checks
No admin operations possible from client without server verification
Anonymous session → authenticated session migration is correct
secrets: No API keys, passwords, or keystores in code or commits
Signing credentials only in GitHub Actions Secrets
No secrets in Drive or docs
reliability: Retries and exponential backoff for transient failures
Idempotency for writes that might be duplicated
Concurrent write races handled with transactions or version checks
free_tier: Cloudflare Workers: <100k req/day, <10ms CPU per invocation
ci: GitHub Actions workflow exists and last run succeeded
APK artifact is uploaded as Actions artifact
Build does not require manual steps
play_readiness: targetSdk is current Google Play requirement
Icons and metadata are not placeholder
